operations.description: Provides MCP server access to Power Apps capabilities including request_assistance for Agent Feed tasks

mcpTools.name: request_assistance
mcpTools.description: Create an Agent Feed task that requires human review/confirmation
mcpTools.usage: Use request_assistance to create a task in the Agent Feed. The task will appear in the user's Power Apps Agent Feed for review.

parameters.title: Task title - should identify the source workflow (e.g. 'FlowWeekly', 'ReturnReview')
parameters.description: What the human reviewer needs to check/confirm
parameters.entityName: Dataverse table logical name to bind the task to (e.g. 'crf5c_orderrecord', 'incident')
parameters.recordId: The Dataverse record ID to associate with the task
parameters.statusOptions: Describe what status changes the user can make (e.g. 'Assign Tasks' to accept, 'Cancel' to reject)

mcpTools.samplePrompt:
Use Power Apps MCP Server request_assistance to create a task:
- title: 'ReturnReview'
- Ask the reviewer to check the return request details and confirm
- If accepted, change status to 'Approved'; if rejected, change to 'Cancelled'
- Bind to entity 'incident' with the created case record ID

toolConfigForDefinition.displayName: Microsoft Power Apps — Power Apps MCP Server

toolConfigForGraph.displayName: Microsoft Power Apps — Power Apps MCP Server

notes: Power Apps MCP connector name is 'shared_powertools' (not 'shared_powerapps'). The request_assistance tool creates Agent Feed tasks for human-in-the-loop scenarios.
